composio.note: Composio has no managed OAuth app for Xero. Create a custom auth config with your own client ID and secret, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio has no managed Xero app, so you must register your own Xero OAuth app and give Composio its client ID and secret.

scenarios.label: Public multi-customer app, certified by Xero
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your AI agent connects many customers' Xero organisations and you want Xero certification and App Store listing.

hands_on.estimate: About 1-2 weeks of work, plus onboarding beta customers
hands_on.basis: Estimate from step count; the assessment typically takes around 5 working days (c10); the beta-customer onboarding time is not measured.

waiting.estimate: 5-10 working days per review, plus remediation if asked
waiting.basis: c10; if remediation is requested, 30 days for a plan and 60 days to implement come on top (c12), then a re-review (c13).

prerequisites.title: Own Xero OAuth app
prerequisites.detail: Composio has no managed Xero app, so register your own and supply its client ID and secret.

prerequisites.title: Xero API plan and payment method
prerequisites.detail: Pricing is a flat monthly fee per app by plan, with overage per GB. A payment method is required from the Core plan upward.

prerequisites.title: 10 beta customers
prerequisites.detail: Beta customers are non-demo tenants with API calls in the last 30 days. Plan to onboard them before you can submit.

steps.title: Create Xero developer app
steps.detail: Log in to the Xero developer portal and register an app. Note the client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: You have a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Check redirect URI rules
steps.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and check it is absolute with no wildcards. Up to 50 URIs can be registered.
steps.done_when: The URI is registered in the Xero app.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config for the xero toolkit through Composio's API with your client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and a test connection works.

steps.title: Choose plan and add payment
steps.detail: Pick a Xero API plan and add a payment method if above Starter.

steps.title: Onboard 10 beta customers
steps.detail: Get 10 real tenants making API calls so the certification form unlocks.
steps.done_when: The certification form is no longer greyed out.

steps.title: Draft security assessment answers
steps.detail: Draft answers against Xero's requirements: authentication, encryption, audit logging, personnel security and certification.
steps.done_when: A draft is ready for your review.

steps.title: Submit assessment and certification
steps.detail: Review the draft and submit through the developer centre.

steps.title: Xero security review
steps.detail: Xero typically takes 5-10 working days to assess answers.
steps.done_when: Xero passes you or requests remediation.

steps.title: Remediate if requested
steps.detail: Submit a remediation plan within 30 days, then implement changes within 60 days. Xero then re-reviews.
steps.done_when: Xero confirms the standards are met.

traps.title: Yearly re-assessment
traps.detail: You must pass the security assessment every year, not only once.

traps.title: Beta customer gate delays certification
traps.detail: The certification form stays greyed out until 10 non-demo tenants have made API calls in the last 30 days.

traps.title: Stricter assessment at 1,000 connections
traps.detail: Reaching 1,000 or more connections triggers an advanced security assessment.

traps.title: Monthly platform fee
traps.detail: You pay Xero a monthly fee tiered by connections and premium features, plus overage per GB of data.

traps.title: Wrong sign-in button labels
traps.detail: One developer report names wrong Sign Up/Sign In button labels as a common cause of certification delays.

traps.title: Redirect URI rules
traps.detail: Wildcards are not supported and URIs must be absolute.

blockers.what_it_means: You have not yet onboarded 10 beta customers with recent API calls.
blockers.what_to_do: Onboard more real customers and make sure each has API calls in the last 30 days.

blockers.symptom: Xero asks for remediation after the assessment
blockers.what_it_means: Some items did not meet the requirements.
blockers.what_to_do: Send a plan within 30 days, implement within 60 days, then wait for re-review.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the remediation plan and list the code or config changes needed.
